phase_machine.purpose: One-time user interview: confirm goal, package scope, comms destinations, cadences, and explicit external-action approvals. Writes config.json + brief.md + channel_state[] + approvals[]. Harness-owned interactive flow, NOT a code worker.
phase_machine.advances_when: config.json validated (exactly one primary channel, every slack target non-empty, channel_state covers configured channels), brief.md written, approvals recorded, and the config was echoed back to the user. Runs on first-start only; never re-entered.

phase_machine.purpose: Fan out read-only workers per topic; persist one raw source-attributed file per topic under research/, digest into CURRENT.md. Package + capability detection runs here (after intake).
phase_machine.advances_when: no research topics remain outstanding (findings for every unknown design needs are written with sources).

phase_machine.purpose: Produce an approved design grounded in brief.md + research/. Worker embeds the brainstorming brain; harness copies the approved artifact to .project-state/design.md and links it in CURRENT.md. Gate auto-waived.
phase_machine.advances_when: design.md landed at .project-state/design.md and linked from CURRENT.md; no open ambiguity/hard/stuck stop.

phase_machine.purpose: Turn design into a task list defining task_cursors[] source-of-truth AND CR slice boundaries (vertical slices, program design before code). Copies plan.md into .project-state/. Gate auto-waived.
phase_machine.advances_when: plan.md landed AND task_cursors == [] (implement owns reservation). No open hard/ambiguity/stuck stop.

phase_machine.purpose: Per task/slice, dispatch a TDD code worker on the slice branch; verify repository evidence; write a completion digest; manage task_cursors[] reservation queue and slice branches.
phase_machine.advances_when: current slice complete (every task in the slice has an accepted+digested cursor) -> Review. Reverse recovery edge -> Plan when no plan/cursor exists. Otherwise seed next dependency-ready task and stay.

phase_machine.purpose: Verification gate (verification-before-completion; conditional adversarial verify on risky surface). On FAIL, bounded fix loop counting review_state.attempts against stuck_threshold.
phase_machine.advances_when: verification PASS with evidence -> Cr (clear review_state). At attempts>=stuck_threshold raise a stuck stop WITHOUT leaving Review.

phase_machine.purpose: Partition slice into review units (one Brazil multi-pkg CR; one PR per GitHub repo), create drafts idempotently, babysit (read-only poll), run serialized fix loop, and gate publish + merge/land as two separate hard stops. NEVER sets done.
phase_machine.advances_when: plan exhausted (task_cursors empty, no slice pending) AND every crs[] element status in {landed,abandoned} -> Confirming. If another slice remains -> Implement (cut its branch). Otherwise stay while any review unit open.

phase_machine.purpose: Always-on human hard-stop that alone declares the project done. Recomputes fire-condition on entry; posts confirm-done recap with [A]/[B]/[C]; never infers acceptance from silence.
phase_machine.advances_when: [A] accept -> Done; [B] new direction -> Research (append brief.md Addendum, archive plan.md, clear task_cursors); [C]/no-reply -> stay. Fire-condition false on entry self-corrects back to Cr/Implement/Plan.

phase_machine.purpose: Terminal idle. Coupled to posture Done: work-track forced false, no routine posts, lease released, harness heartbeat off.
phase_machine.advances_when: never advances on its own; only a fresh user ask reopens it.

worker_contract:
Model: WORKER PROPOSES, HARNESS DISPOSES. The Rust harness is the deterministic coordinator; each phase's 'brain' is a stateless one-shot LLM worker. Reuse the EXISTING detached-tmux+done-signal substrate (tmux.rs Driver::spawn_step / observe): the daemon sweep stays single-threaded and NEVER blocks on a worker.

Per phase-unit tick the harness: (1) builds the phase prompt = borrowed playbook text (verbatim, compiled in via include_str!) + injected context (state facts, CURRENT.md-linked file pointers, acceptance criteria, binding decisions, principles.md block) + a strict REQUIRED-OUTPUT contract; (2) resolves worker route from plan annotations + capabilities (claude default, codex for mechanical, Package:->cwd, Parallel-with->Workflow fan-out capped at multi_agent.max_parallel); (3) spawns the worker detached via the existing wrapper, extended so the pane runs `env -u CLAUDECODE claude -p --permission-mode <plan|acceptEdits> --no-session-persistence --output-format stream-json --verbose --forward-subagent-text [--add-dir ...] -- <prompt>` (or `codex -a never -s workspace-write exec --ephemeral [--add-dir ...] -- <prompt>`), with stdout(=stream-json trace) -> steps/<seq>.log, exit code -> done-signal, and the worker instructed to write its machine result to steps/<seq>.result.json as its final action; bounded by GNU timeout (multi_agent.timeout_s) < renewed lease.

On done-signal, the harness parses a WorkerResult { proposed_transition: Option<Phase>, stay: bool, stops: Vec<StopDraft{kind,question,options,context_ref,risk_class}>, artifacts_written: Vec<Path>, operations: Vec<OpIntent>, digest: Option<CompletionDigest{task_ids,commit_ref,tests,files}>, notes } and VERIFIES rather than trusts it: for code phases, repository evidence (git diff scope, tests added+pass, commit exists) is the acceptance gate — exit 0 / self-claim is never acceptance; for claude code workers, the stream-json trace must prove an ordered chain (successful superpowers:test-driven-development Skill result in a strictly-earlier assistant record than a successful Agent/Workflow result, matched by tool_use_id, name==req || endswith(\"__\"+req)); codex/async workers have NO trace validator (repo evidence only). The harness then validates the proposed transition against can_transition(from,to,guards) (hard-reject cr->done), applies integrity (checkpoint seal, operations reconcile), and commits ALL control-state itself via write_json_atomic — the worker only ever writes artifacts (design.md/plan.md/research-*/code) and the result descriptor, never state.json/checkpoint. Missing/unparseable result, failed proof, timeout (exit 124/137), or repo contradiction => keep the cursor and raise worker_stuck (posture NeedsYou); a proposed illegal transition => ambiguity/stuck stop, never silent obey.

stop_risk_table.rationale: Reviewer-visible external mutation (cr --publish / gh pr ready). Already in ALWAYS_HARD_KINDS. Per-CR authorization required; never auto-flowed at any tier.
Land/merge is irreversible and a SEPARATE hard stop from publish. Always escalate; per-review-unit explicit approval.
Project-boundary gate — plan-exhausted is the coordinator's signal, not the user's. Never infer acceptance from silence/timeout; escalate on every tier including autopilot.

Verification failed stuck_threshold times (verify-don't-assume never waives). Auto-flowing would ship unverified/broken code, so it must always halt — classify Hard (add to the forced-hard floor), diverging from a naive Medium mapping.
Missing required CLI/tmux/tool or exhausted worker-route fallbacks. No human answer proceeds without fixing the environment; escalate always, never implement inline.

A blocking worker timed out/failed or an async worker was reaped. Autopilot may auto-flow = auto-retry with a fresh worker (bounded) before escalating; Standard/Guardian escalate. Options [A]retry/[B]alt-surface/[C]show/[D]skip carried as data ([D] needs a sourced decisions.md entry).

Genuine fork with >1 defensible answer (design/plan/implement/cr mapping). Autopilot auto-flows with a recorded default decision; Standard/Guardian escalate with lettered options. This is the deliberate tier divergence from the skill's single-tier always-halt.
Pre-contact domain outreach question. Autopilot can auto-flow (search-first/skip per frozen policy); higher tiers escalate. Migrates to expert_asks[] only after an approved DM.

tier_gating:
Keep the existing 3-tier model (config.autonomy: Autopilot|Standard|Guardian) and the existing policy.rs machinery, layering the skill's stop semantics as the safety floor. Decision pipeline per raised stop: effective_risk(stop) = if kind in ALWAYS_HARD_KINDS (publish, merge, land, deploy, confirm_done, credentials, payment, destructive, PLUS newly-added stuck & capability) -> Hard, else the coordinator-labelled risk_class. Then decide(tier, risk): Hard => Escalate at EVERY tier; Autopilot auto-flows Medium+Low; Standard/Guardian escalate Medium, auto-flow Low. Auto-flow = the harness synthesizes an 'auto' answer into answers.json (answered_by=\"auto_flow\"), records a source-attributed decisions.md note, and the next phase-worker dispatch consumes it — this reuses on_needs_you/stops_requiring_human exactly as coded today. The daemon also re-derives the hard floor as a belt-and-suspenders safety net even if a worker mislabels risk_class.

Crucially, PHASE GATES are always auto-waived at every tier (design/plan approval is NEVER a stop) — matching the skill's max-autonomy; tier gating governs ONLY the soft stops (ambiguity, worker_stuck, expert_needed). The stop-vs-autoflow decision is per-action and binary: does a stop trigger fire and survive the tier/risk gate? If yes -> append open_stops[] + set posture NeedsYou (only after all independent runnable work is exhausted; independent work keeps posture Working); if no -> auto-flow and continue. Guardian currently equals Standard for the soft stops (an open question: should Guardian also escalate Low, or add a per-phase confirmation?).

integrity_mechanisms.name: Atomic durable writes
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: No reader ever sees a torn/partial JSON; a rename is durable across crash.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: Reuse state::write_json_atomic verbatim (temp+fsync+rename+dir fsync, pretty JSON). Route every control-state write through it; one writer (the harness) per control file.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Worker-proposes / harness-disposes
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: Control state (phase, run, cursors, crs, ops) is never mutated by an untrusted LLM; illegal states are unrepresentable from a worker.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: Workers write only artifacts + steps/<seq>.result.json; the harness alone writes state.json after validating the proposal against the transition table and integrity gates.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Transition allowlist + guards
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: Only the state-machine.md legal transitions occur; cr->done can never happen.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: fn can_transition(from,to,guards)->bool as an explicit allowlist; hard-code the cr->done rejection; guards = topics_remain, slice_boundary_reached, plan_exhausted, all_crs_terminal, another_slice_remains, confirm_decision, attempts>=stuck_threshold, etc.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Checkpoint sealing (3 canonical hashes)
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: A validated ledger cannot be silently mutated between seal and resume; distinguishes material change vs poll/journal bookkeeping.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: checkpoint.rs: Checkpoint{control_state,material_state,journal_guard: sha256 over sorted-key canonical JSON with the documented deletions/nullings} + enum SealKind{Baseline,Material,NoChange,Journal} + seal()/verify(); seal requires pm-validate pass + lease-held; verify compares the durable subset (excludes state.json raw hash + poll bookkeeping).

integrity_mechanisms.name: Operations idempotency journal
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: Every external mutation (branch, push, draft-cr, publish, merge, post) happens at most once even across crashes.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: ops.rs: Vec<Operation> keyed by deterministic unique key (e.g. draft-cr:<review-unit>:<slice_id> where review-unit=sorted,%-encoded packages joined '+'); begin_operation persists pending BEFORE the network call; reconcile-before-retry; retry resets same key to pending (never duplicate). Monotonic transitions pending->{completed,failed}, failed->{pending(new started_at),completed}.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Repository-evidence acceptance
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: A worker's success claim / exit 0 is never task acceptance; hallucinated completions are rejected.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: verify.rs: inspect git diff scope, changed-files-within-task, required tests added+pass, commit ref exists; identical gate for blocking and async returns. Cursor kept and worker_stuck raised on any mismatch.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Claude trace proof
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: A claude code worker actually invoked TDD before delegating and its orchestration call succeeded.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: Parse steps/<seq>.log (stream-json, slurped as complete records): require a successful superpowers:test-driven-development Skill tool_use/result in a strictly-earlier assistant record than a successful Agent/Workflow result, matched by tool_use_id, with name==req || name.ends_with("__"+req). Read-only routes drop the Skill requirement (permission-mode plan).

integrity_mechanisms.name: Coordinator lease + identity
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: Exactly one driver per project; a stale/foreign session can't drive.
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: Reuse lease.rs flock ProjectLease (kernel auto-release on crash). Extend the owner record with (run_id, session_id) to reproduce the skill's continuation gate and the coordinator_lease_s>=timeout_s+60 renewal-before-dispatch rule.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Poll-cursor monotonicity
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: Poll cursors never move backward and never exceed the seal time (except a CR going terminal nulls its cursor).
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: cursor_forward(before,after) check applied to timers.work + all last_polled during seal; excluded from material_state so poll-only advances re-seal as no-change.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Never-blanket-approval denylist
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: Enforce in the approval-grant code path (not just prompt): reject any Approval whose action is on the denylist unless scoped per-action; belt-and-suspenders with ALWAYS_HARD_KINDS at the stop gate.

integrity_mechanisms.name: Phase-aware schema validation
integrity_mechanisms.guarantee: Ledger invariants beyond serde shape hold (lease>=timeout+60, channel coverage, CR branch-chain, id uniqueness, terminal-CR cursor null).
integrity_mechanisms.rust_approach: validate.rs returning {valid,errors[]}; serde deny_unknown_fields for keys_exact; extra checks ported from pm-validate.sh; a phase-aware mode tolerates the partially-invalid intake scaffold.

Comms transport: reuse the Slack MCP through a worker, or build a native Slack client in Rust? Authorized-responder resolution needs authenticated sender identity — where does that come from without the MCP?
Async/tmux codex worker route (posture Monitoring): keep it in v1 or ship blocking-only first and add detached async later? It is the only source of Monitoring and adds real complexity.

Checkpoint sealing depth for v1: full 3-hash parity (control/material/journal) or a simplified single control-state hash? The current agent-manager has no checkpoint at all, and its atomic-write + one-writer model already covers most crash safety.

Hook/session/heartbeat parity: since the harness owns scheduling natively (daemon sweep), do we drop the Stop/UserPromptSubmit hooks, session.protocol sentinel, and cron entirely, keeping only lease+posture+due? Recommend yes, but confirm no interop need.

Playbook text storage: compile borrowed prompts in via include_str! (drift-frozen, zero runtime dependency — matches the ask) vs a data dir the operator can edit? And how to track upstream skill drift.
Package detection + brazil-vs-github worktree isolation asymmetry: port fully in v1 (needed for real Amazon projects) or defer and support single-package github first?

Multi-phase-per-wake: the skill chains research->design->plan in one entry. Do we run multiple phase transitions per sweep tick (until a stop/wait), or one transition per tick? One-per-tick is simpler and the daemon sweeps frequently; confirm latency is acceptable.
biggest_risks: Conflating phase (intake..done) with posture (working/monitoring/needs_you/done) — they share the token 'done' but are orthogonal; only confirming->[A] flips both. Modeling them as one field would corrupt the machine. Today's code has only posture (StepStatus) and no phase; adding phase without keeping them distinct is the top risk.

cr->done leak / premature confirming: forgetting the (plan_exhausted && all_crs_terminal) guard, or not hard-rejecting cr->done in the validator, lets the project declare itself done with open reviews. The confirming fire-condition recompute-on-entry is the safety net and must run first.

Trusting worker self-claims instead of repository evidence — an LLM worker reporting success without a real commit/tests would let hallucinated or unverified work advance the phase and eventually ship. The repo-evidence gate + claude trace proof are load-bearing and easy to under-implement.

Incomplete integrity port: a partial operations journal or missing checkpoint reconcile => double external actions after a crash (double draft-CR, double publish/push, double Slack post). Operation-key exactness (esp. the review-unit derivation: sorted, %-encoded, '+'-joined) is fragile and breaks dedup silently if wrong.

Worker prompt/result-contract drift: if the borrowed playbook text and the required WorkerResult schema diverge, workers return unparseable results and the loop wedges. Needs a strict result schema, a parse-failure -> worker_stuck fallback, and prompt/contract co-versioning.

Safety regression vs the skill from tiering: auto-flowing on Autopilot a stop the skill says must always halt (I mapped stuck+capability to Hard precisely to avoid this, but ambiguity auto-flow on Autopilot means the harness picks a default fork silently — this can quietly diverge from user intent and must be logged + bounded).

Single-threaded daemon blocking: if a phase worker were run synchronously it would freeze scheduling for every project. Mitigated ONLY by reusing the existing detached-tmux+observe substrate — a synchronous claude -p (as pm-worker.sh does) must NOT be ported literally.

Authorized-responder spoofing: resolving a hard stop (esp. publish/merge/confirm_done) on an unauthenticated or spoofable Slack reply. Identity must be verified against authorized_responders by authenticated sender id, and silence must never auto-resolve.

Scope explosion: the skill is ~5 slices of deep behavior (comms, expert outreach, async workers, adversarial verify, brazil/github isolation, checkpoint sealing). Attempting full parity in one pass risks a stalled port; the biggest project risk is not sequencing an MVP (phase machine + blocking claude worker + repo-evidence + basic stops/tiers) before the integrity/comms depth.
